name: @ahakey/plugin-sdk
description: TypeScript SDK for AhaKey desktop plugins

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/hello-plugin/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/lever-counter/tsconfig.json
scripts.demo: npm run build && AHAKEY_PLUGINS_DIR="$PWD/examples" swift run --package-path ../../ahakeyconfig-mac PluginShowcase
scripts.demo:cli: npm run build && AHAKEY_PLUGINS_DIR="$PWD/examples" swift run --package-path ../../ahakeyconfig-mac Plugin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:sdk && tsc -p examples/hello-plugin/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/lever-counter/tsconfig.json --noEmit
